beats.title: Party mobilizes the crowd at the first venue
beats.summary: The party is at the Copper and Quartz, where Bonogo posts wanted flyers for the hooded figure and Stafl turns the crowd toward the Glimmering Globe for a bardic competition. Caelynn works the room, Bonogo spots the hooded figure briefly, and Baergrom tries to sway dwarves to Stafl.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:14-14
anchor_quotes: the party is in full swing at the Copper and Quartz
Bonogo, using the paper he acquired earlier in the city, makes some “Wanted” posters of the hooded figure
He hangs up a couple around the Inn then hangs on to the rest
Stafl then whips the crowd up and he leads them down the street to the Glimmering Globe for the Bardic Storytelling Competition
Caelynn moves through the crowd getting them involved and hyped up
Baergrom joins a group of dwarves, attempting to sway them to Stafl

beats.title: Competitors revealed and the Dustwalker exposed
beats.summary: On stage, Stafl gathers the other competitors and the performance lineup unfolds. After asking about the shadowy figure, Stafl learns it is the Dustwalker; the group confronts him, Bonogo throws daggers, and Caelynn seeks city help through the guard before the fight begins.

anchor_quotes: Stafl calls for all the other competitors to come out and join him
the shadowy figure who remains just off stage

Stafl quickly calls all the members of Questionable Company back to stage
Bonogo immediately throws a dagger at the Dustwalker
Caelynn then runs to the guard, asking for them to contact Lesandra through their “rocky-talky”
Then the battle begins

beats.title: The stage fight escalates and the crowd is magically controlled
beats.summary: The Dustwalker and red-cloaked allies trade heavy magical and weapon attacks with Bonogo while Caelynn wipes out much of the escort. The Dustwalker charms the crowd, Stafl forces a partial evacuation, and a fear effect creates a barrier at the stage.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:18-18
anchor_quotes: the Dustwalker took a good amount of damage from the dagger throw

casts Word of the Shepherd and the crowd becomes charmed
The red cloaks, called the Crimson Chorus, cast a spell on Bonogo then attack him for big damage
Stafl quickly uses Suggestion on the Half-Orc and the crowd near the stage
He then casts Celestial Revelation and uses Necrotic Shroud to frighten the remaining front row of the crowd, creating a barrier to the stage

beats.title: Dustwalker killed again, panic calmed, and the Academy cell discovered
beats.summary: Caelynn finishes off the remaining red cloaks and the Dustwalker, which breaks the crowd spell but causes panic until Ephanna calms everyone. Lesandra arrives to take notes and warn the group, after which Karsemine and Bonogo rush to the Academy, find the Dustwalker apparently back in its cell, and clash with the guard before killing the captive again and fleeing as guards arrive.
